method: Run each arm 5 or more times on a local dev server (PROVENDER_BASE_URL set on every ./scripts/prov call). Hand each rep the scenario file as step 1's scrape output, and stop it after step 4 with the draft written to a scratch path, so nothing is saved. Score the draft JSON. A rep that misses a canary is discarded, not scored.
canaries: Every ingredient has an ingredientName and a category.

regressions.source: Ingredients gain a required scaling kind (#220). Step 2 lists the four kinds.
asserts: Every ingredient in the draft sets scaling.
Salt and cinnamon are seasoning, baking powder and baking soda are leavening, and eggs are whole.
regressions.baseline: 5/5 control reps passed both asserts. Each read GET /openapi.json, whose IngredientInput marks scaling required and describes the four kinds, so this scenario cannot tell the arms apart.
regressions.result: Edited skill: 5/5 passed both asserts, 3 of them without reading /openapi.json. The skill text ships because the design asks add-recipe to set scaling, and this repo keeps workflow steps in SKILL.md only.

regressions.source: A brace names its ingredient, {1 tsp|cumin}, so the step scales on that ingredient's curve (#221). Step 2 asks for a link in every brace.
regressions.control: The skill before #221, run in a worktree whose AGENTS.md already states the link rule.
asserts: Every brace in the draft's instructions ends with | and a name.
Each link matches an ingredientName in the same draft, ignoring case.
regressions.baseline: 0/5 control reps passed: every rep marked 11-13 braces, none with a link.
regressions.result: Edited skill: 5/5 passed both asserts, 11-12 braces per rep. Every rep linked both butter amounts to the one butter ingredient.
